card.name: The word light after shed
card.fires_on: The word "light" right after a form of "shed" (shedding, shed some, sheds), as in "shed light on". It also fires weakly on "consensus" after "no (real)" and on "tells" in "what it tells you".

modes.label: Shed light on
modes.description: "light" completes the idiom "shed light on" about a topic being clarified.
modes.example: is shedding<< light>> on the evolution of this virus.

modes.label: No consensus
modes.description: "consensus" after "no" or "no real" when saying experts disagree.
modes.example: On this point, there is no<< consensus>>. Some acknowledge

modes.label: Tells you
modes.description: "tells" after "what it" introducing a conclusion drawn from data.
modes.example: not how many fish were spawned. “What it<< tells>> you is that there is high variability.
